headline: Asian stock market summary: close (31st)
summary: Chinese stock markets rose, with tech stocks attracting afternoon buying while real estate shares plunged. The CSI 300 gained 0.4% and the Shanghai Composite ended up about 1%.
why: The Shanghai Composite and CSI 300 are the main benchmarks for mainland China's listed stocks, so their moves reflect sentiment toward the Chinese economy and its sectors.
